owner_authorization.recorded_from: Recorded project-owner delegation permits bounded QA, exact-copy checks and source-conflict investigation. This implements the saved coordination queue after evidence-bound closure of MEC-SEA-ROCK-PREFLIGHT-001.
owner_authorization.scope_note: Source content stays read-only; only the three audit outputs may be written. No new canon, printed copy, mechanic, engine repair, visual production or simulation is authorized.

execution_baseline.branch_must_start_at: The exact task-activation commit; coordinator fast-forwards the accepted Simulation branch to that commit. Stop on branch drift instead of resetting specialist work.

source_package.usage: Verify size/hash against pinned v2.6 manifest, then nested manifest members; inspect authoritative text/spec data without running the game engine. Package access and verified member paths/hashes belong in evidence.

audit.purpose: Explain exact visible-copy coverage for all 121 expected card identities and identify what must be resolved before copy/layout production.
audit.source_precedence: Current contract: project-owner override, then canonical v2.7 character/power copy; verified locked baseline may supply remaining categories only with explicit source tracing and conflict disclosure.
audit.identity_manifest_usage: The 121-record art manifest is an identity and completeness cross-check only. Its brief prose is not canonical printed copy and cannot fill missing fields. Reconcile its identity/category counts with the locked card baseline and package.
record_requirements: One result row per expected identity, plus separately listed duplicate, missing, extra or conflicting source identities.

For every visible field, preserve exact UTF-8 source text and a path/member, JSON pointer or line locator, and Git blob or package-member hash. Do not silently normalize Turkish letters, whitespace or punctuation.
Use explicit RESOLVED, MISSING_SOURCE, SOURCE_CONFLICT or NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_REASON per field; unresolved fields remain null, not invented copy.
Separate expected identity coverage, source-located visible fields, current resolver coverage and independently accepted production copy. Their counts must not be conflated.
Preserve SRC-002 mappings: GUC-22 Kaptanın Çatlak Kupası; GUC-23 Bayat Peksimet; GUC-24 Islak Çorap. Preserve exact SET-KP-01 owner copy.
Provide a short discrepancy queue with exact sources, impact and responsible role; identify decisions requiring project-owner input without taking those decisions.
audit.result_limit: Even complete source location is not full-deck exact-copy acceptance, print proof or production authorization.

acceptance_criteria: Only the three exact audit outputs change cumulatively from the activation commit; accepted Sea/Rock evidence and every source remain byte-exact.
Record authority/source/activation commits, all input and package member hashes, environment and a reproducible command; provide a read-only --check mode. No game engine is executed.
Reconcile all expected identities and category counts; derive counts from records and explicitly enumerate gaps, conflicts, duplicates and any unsupported printed fields.
Every populated visible field has verifiable source provenance and correct precedence; art briefs, image OCR guesses, model-generated text and inferred mechanics cannot substitute for source copy.
RESULTS and REPORT agree on one allowed result. Keep the report concise; full per-identity/per-field evidence belongs in JSON.
All production, thumbnail, simulation, PDF, release and lock permissions remain false; no blocker is closed by the executor.
CHIEF_EDITOR independently verifies the delivery commit, cumulative scope, source pins, result completeness and exact blobs before acceptance or closure.

handoff.read_scope: Current authority, this exact task, pinned copy/source hierarchy and only package members needed for the inventory. Expand only to resolve a documented source conflict.
